constraints.source_text: fulfillment of USC general education requirements including third semester equivalency in a foreign language
constraints.description: Students must complete USC general education requirements including third-semester foreign language equivalency.

details.requirement: third semester equivalency in a foreign language

constraints.note: No specific course list given for language equivalency.

constraints.source_text: It requires eight courses in six Core Literacies, plus two courses in Global Perspectives (which may double-count with courses in the Core Literacies) and two courses in writing.
constraints.description: Students must complete the university general education program consisting of eight Core Literacies courses, two Global Perspectives courses, and two writing courses.
constraints.note: General education structure described without an enumerated course list specific to this program.

constraints.source_text: As part of the core research requirements, students must complete a directed research requirement, HP 490, with a specific international research focus.
constraints.description: Students must complete HP 490 as a directed research course.
constraints.note: The 'specific international research focus' qualifier is not encodable as a plan constraint.

constraints.source_text: BISC 220Lg General Biology: Cell Biology and Physiology Units: 4 or BISC 221Lg Advanced General Biology: Cell Biology and Physiology Units: 4 ; CHEM 105aLg General Chemistry Units: 4 or CHEM 115aLg Advanced General Chemistry Units: 4 ; ECON 203g Principles of Microeconomics Units: 4 ; HP 270 Introduction to Global Health Units: 4 ; HP 320 Biological and Behavioral Basis of Disease Units: 4 ; HP 470 Case Studies in Global Health Units: 4 ; IR 308gw Economic Globalization Units: 4 ; MATH 108g Contemporary Precalculus Units: 4 or MATH 125g Calculus I Units: 4
constraints.description: Students must complete the Core Courses (32 units), including fixed courses and pairs of alternative course options.

constraints.source_text: HP 340Lg Health Behavior Statistical Methods Units: 4 ; HP 350L Health Behavior Research Methods Units: 4 ; HP 490x Directed Research Units: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8 , max 12 (Core Research Courses (10-16 Units))
constraints.description: Students must complete 10 to 16 units of Core Research Courses from the listed set.
constraints.note: Requirement is a unit range (10-16) rather than a single bound; represented with min/max keys.

constraints.source_text: Students must choose 24 units of elective course work from the following lists. At least 8 units must be from HP and at least 8 units must be from IR.
constraints.description: Students must complete 24 elective units total, with at least 8 units from HP Electives, at least 8 units from IR Electives, and the remainder (up to 8 units) from Other Electives.

unclassified.source_text: The Bachelor of Science degree is awarded after students successfully complete 128 units, consisting of 66 units for the major and fulfillment of USC general education requirements including third semester equivalency in a foreign language.
unclassified.why: This is a summary/overview statement combining total-degree unit counts already captured elsewhere; the 128/66 unit split is descriptive rather than a distinct actionable constraint.
